_purpose: Final settings run (3D_Code/production/finalise.py): settles the remaining open settings of the production model used for the parameter sweeps (output step, time step, beats, domain, conductivities, mesh spacing). Forward model and bath are fixed before the run (forwardModelDecision, bath). Every rule below is fixed before the run; finalise.py only applies them. Keys starting with '_' are documentation.

tissue._conductivities: Roberts and Scher 1982 ratios, magnitudes tuned to the CV target at each mesh spacing (DL-2026-10-28-04; tuning at the production spacing, DL-10 as confirmed 1 Nov 2026).
tissue._blood: Traugott, Quail and White 1981 (135 ohm cm).
tissue._cvCalibration: DL-2026-11-02-03: conductivities kept at the measured Roberts and Scher 1982 values; the CV target is reached by beta = 0.14 / s, where s is the conductivity scale the tune stage finds (identical Vm; beta does not enter the extracellular field). 'conductivity' = the earlier choice (conductivities x s, default beta).

domains._purpose: Candidate tissue domains (x along propagation, y across the lesion boundary). Chosen by the recompute stage rule.

bath._source: ASSUMPTION, not tested (DL-2026-11-02-02): bath modelled as Leenknegt, Panfilov and Dierckx 2023, Front. Physiol. 14:1213218 (openCARP slab 'surrounded by a bath of 5 mm in all three directions', no-flux outer boundary, 'grounded region of 1 mm3' at a bath corner). Blood conductivity stays 0.74 S/m (Traugott et al. 1981; Leenknegt used 0.7 S/m). Unipolar potentials are referenced to that corner.

tolerances._source: DL-2026-10-28-05 (CV, PP, change point), VL-2026-10-28-06 clarification (supported change points only, no support-status change), confirmed 1 Nov 2026. contributionFieldL1 is PROPOSED and must be confirmed before the run.
tolerances._contributionFieldL1: PROPOSED: L1 distance between two contribution-share fields on 0.5 mm voxels, sum|a-b| / sum|b|, maximum over the ground-truth recordings.
tolerances._forwardModelMatch: DL-2026-10-28-11, confirmed 1 Nov 2026: openCARP pseudo-bidomain phi_e vs the sigma_m extracellular solve at electrode samples, every run.

rules._recompute: From the existing readiness ladder runs (no simulation), with CV, PP and (full-domain runs only) supported change points; FOV80 reported, not used (ground truth replaced 1 Nov 2026).
rules.sampleStep: 0.2 ms if output_0.20_vs_0.10 passes, else 0.1 ms
rules.timeStep: 20 us if timestep_20_vs_10 passes (CV and PP; reduced slab, so no change points), else 10 us
rules.beats: 4 if beats_4_vs_8 passes (CV and PP; reduced slab), else 8
rules.domain: pilot (40 x 60 mm) if domain_40x60_vs_60x90 passes (CV, PP, supported change points), else large (60 x 90 mm)
rules.spacing: Chosen model and bath: 0.5 mm if the matched-CV comparison 0.5 vs 0.25 mm passes (CV, calibrated PP, supported change points, contribution field), else 0.25 mm and a flag that 0.25 vs 0.125 mm is not yet shown. Calibrated PP because the meshes have different tuned conductivity magnitudes; raw PP is reported.
rules._ppModes: Calibrated PP for the matched-CV mesh comparison (conductivity magnitudes differ by design); raw PP is reported.
rules.scar: not decided here; insulating as the pilot until you decide R10

prepacing._purpose: openCARP runs monodomain (no extracellular solve) up to restartMs, saves its state, and restarts with the bath switched on (slab.py). Vm and activation times are kept from t = 0, so the physiology checks are unchanged. Equal to a continuous run (container check 1 Nov 2026: Vm identical, phi_e within 1e-7 mV, activation times identical).
prepacing._restartMarginMs: restartMs = last-beat earliest window start (stimulus end + 5 ms) - 2 x filter history - margin, on a 10 ms grid: 1050 ms for 4 beats at 500 ms.

solver._purpose: carputils solver flavour for openCARP. boomeramg (hypre AMG, a standard carputils flavour) solved the bath about 8x faster than the default petsc (GAMG) at the same tolerance, results equal to float precision (container, 1 Nov 2026). preflight runs a 1 ms smoke test and falls back to petsc if this build lacks hypre.

_phieOutputHeightMm: phi_e is written only on the bath layer up to this height above the tissue (openCARP dataout_e = 3). The pilot electrodes reach 2 mm (1 mm gap + 1 mm electrode); 3 mm leaves one 0.5 mm element of margin plus 0.5 mm. A sample outside the layer stops the analysis (NaN check). For sweeps with larger standoffs, raise it to the largest standoff + electrode length + 1 mm.

forwardModelDecision.reason: openCARP pseudo-bidomain phi_e is used for every electrogram. The forwardModel rule chose sigma_i only on the contribution-field criterion, whose tolerance (0.10) was proposed and never confirmed: field L1 max 0.109, median 0.003 over 48 recordings. The confirmed criteria passed: calibrated PP max 4.2 % (tolerance 5 %), supported change-point shift 0.1 mm (0.5 mm), no support-status change. Raw amplitude differs (gain 0.158 vs 0.040); the pipeline's gain calibration removes it. Overrides the rule outcome; see DL-2026-11-02-01.
